name: Pandarian Dragon Turtle
appearance: A large dragon turtle used as a mount. The existing portrait shows a broad armored shell and a horned head on plain parchment.
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Printed source: D&D: World of Warcraft, Chapter 3, Mounts and Vehicles. Digital stat block.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The turtle breathes in air and underwater.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the bite is Grappled, escape DC 13.
sections.Source notes: The publisher’s contents page locates the block in Chapter 3. The public image of the digital block has no folio. The upstream catalog lists p. 104.
